shipping_page.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping_page.digital_body: All digital products are delivered instantly after payment. You will receive a secure download link via email, and the file will also appear in your account under "My Downloads". There is no waiting — your purchase is available the moment your payment is confirmed.
shipping_page.physical_body: Physical items are dispatched within 1–3 business days from our warehouse. Standard shipping takes 5–10 business days. Express shipping (2–3 days) is available at checkout for an additional fee.
shipping_page.tracking_body: Once your order ships, you will receive a tracking number by email so you can monitor delivery in real time.
shipping_page.free_body: Enjoy free standard shipping on all physical orders over $75.

returns_page.title: Returns & Refunds
returns_page.physical_body: You may return any physical product within 30 days of delivery, provided it is unused and in its original packaging. Contact our support team to initiate a return — we will cover the return shipping cost.
returns_page.digital_body: Because digital files are delivered immediately and cannot be "returned", all digital sales are final once the download link has been accessed. If you experience a technical issue preventing download, contact us and we will resolve it promptly.
returns_page.refund_body: Approved refunds are processed within 3–5 business days back to your original payment method.
returns_page.damaged_body: If your order arrives damaged or is incorrect, please contact us within 48 hours with a photo and we will send a replacement at no cost.

support_page.title: Customer Support
support_page.email_body: Reach us any time at support@techstore.com. Our team responds within 2 hours on business days and within 6 hours on weekends.
support_page.hours_body: Our support team is available Monday–Sunday, 08:00–22:00 (UTC+5). For urgent issues outside these hours, email us and we will respond as soon as possible.
support_page.faq_body: Check the Shipping and Returns pages first — most common questions are answered there. For account or payment issues, include your order number in your message for a faster response.
support_page.response_body: General enquiries: under 2 hours. Technical issues: under 4 hours. Refund requests: 1 business day.

guarantee_page.title: Quality Guarantee
guarantee_page.promise_body: Every product listed on TechStore has been reviewed and tested by our team. We only stock items we would use ourselves.
guarantee_page.digital_body: All digital products include full documentation, are free of malware, and are verified to work as described. If a file is corrupt or incomplete, we will replace it immediately.
guarantee_page.physical_body: All gadgets pass a quality inspection before dispatch. We only partner with reputable manufacturers and do not sell counterfeit goods.
guarantee_page.satisfaction_body: If you are not satisfied with your purchase for any reason, contact us within 14 days and we will work with you to find a solution — whether that is a replacement, store credit, or a refund.
